content.title: The Definition of Chalcedon (451)
content.author: Council of Chalcedon, 451 · traditional English text, as held in this site's creeds collection
content.note: The council's statement that the one Lord Jesus Christ is truly God and truly man, complete in Godhead and in manhood, known in two natures without confusion, change, division or separation. It identifies the doctrine being defended; it is not independent historical evidence. Public domain: may be quoted, with an exact locator (the site's text is one paragraph).
